fusions.name: Both Fists Down
fusions.desc: Pounds the shield flat into the ground with both fists, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Overhand Wreck
fusions.desc: Brings the shield down two-handed, which deals 34 damage that ignores armour, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 18% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Chest Thunder
fusions.desc: Drums the shield against your chest: up to 5 enemies within 5 tiles are pulled onto you for 6 seconds, and your blunt damage rises by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: It Grips Back
fusions.desc: When a blow lands on you from anything but fire, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
